header.provenance: Published OBJ triangle geometry only; no run or recording data.
header.notice: Map-derived prior from the published layout (rule 6.4), not fixed flight waypoints or timings. Runtime must localise and react to live perception (generality, rule 9.5). Coordinates are preliminary and may change.
header.height_band_definition: Allowed sampled centre heights, NOT a full-height vehicle envelope. Main occupancy is one horizontal slice, not a union across the band.

occupancy.indexing: cells[row_y][column_x]; rows increase with +Y, columns with +X
occupancy.out_of_map: OutOfMapError; extent is half-open, including minimum and excluding maximum.

values.0: No modelled material in this cell at the selected height; body clearance remains unverified.

mask_definition: Bit i is 1 exactly when the cell is free at sample_heights_m[i]. This does not establish safe motion between heights.

unknowns.reason: Vehicle dimensions and localisation uncertainty are not supplied; sampled point/square clearance is not whole-drone clearance.
Occupancy between sampled heights is not certified; route prior uses one layer without vertical transitions.
